Iteration 1/25, stage explore, attempt 1.
Research goal: investigate which measured predictors and subgroups are associated with scientifically meaningful differences in outcome_012 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_005 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_015 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_002 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_016 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_007 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_013 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_014 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_004 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_009 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_010 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_001 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_008 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_003 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_006 (CRISPR dependency score), outcome_011 (CRISPR dependency score). Use the supplied dataset to discover and follow up comparisons, assess effect sizes and uncertainty, and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Use independent validation when useful and distinguish findings in this dataset from claims about causality or generalizability.
Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Your action now: Propose scientifically useful new comparisons or refinements for later analysis.

record.narrative: Wave 1 is a breadth-first screen over well-populated measured predictors with 16 CRISPR dependency outcomes. More negative dependency scores indicate stronger dependency, so a positive exposed-minus-comparator contrast means weaker dependency in the exposed group. I selected binary predictors with full observation and enough observations in every cell, plus one safely two-level categorical predictor. For many binary markers, exposed=1 versus comparator=0 tests whether marker presence is associated with weaker dependency; when a marker plausibly represents a protective or compensatory feature, exposed=0 versus comparator=1 tests whether absence strengthens dependency. Anticipated directions are stated as the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence, while direction records the hypothesis to be signed in later estimates. I also included two subgroup mean differences with very large subgroup sizes to test whether common marker effects are retained in large molecular contexts; these were chosen so both subgroup cells have ample size even under adverse marker overlap. The 10% clinical significance threshold is approximately 0.02-0.03 dependency-score units for the typical outcomes with means near -0.25, and possibly smaller for flatter outcome means, so interval width and practical magnitude will matter. These claims are observational and may reflect biology, confounding, or cohort structure; independent validation and mechanistic interpretation are deferred.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct

with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due

For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

record.narrative:
Wave 1 provides discovery evidence for 12 broad, cell-safe comparisons. No claim meets a sufficiently strict evidence bar for acceptance: none has a signed 95% interval whose lower bound exceeds the approximately 10% relative clinical-relevance threshold in the hypothesized direction, and none has a precise interval excluding the null while also indicating a clinically meaningful magnitude. Because these are 12 simultaneous observational screens, I applied multiplicity caution and did not treat borderline confidence-interval crossings as discoveries. For claims where the signed upper bound was clearly below a 10% relative effect in the hypothesized direction, I rejected the directional claim even though the intervals sometimes left open the possibility of an opposite association: H4, H7, H9, and H10 had maximum supported effects in the claimed direction that were too small to be clinically meaningful. I did not accept those opposite effects because reversing after a null screen would be data-driven and would worsen multiplicity.

H3 is the only candidate strong enough to warrant independent validation. Its signed estimate for outcome_006 feature_060=1 versus 0 is +0.0194, corresponding to a raw negative contrast (stronger dependency in the exposed group). Relative to the inferred comparator mean for outcome_006, this point estimate is roughly in the 10-12% clinically relevant range, and the interval upper bound is well above that threshold. However, the interval also includes zero and negative signed values, so this dataset alone does not establish the effect. I therefore marked H3 unresolved but active and requested validation. If validation confirms the signed negative raw contrast with an independent interval consistent with a clinically meaningful magnitude, H3 could be upgraded; if validation attenuates or reverses, it should remain non-accepted or rejected.

H1, H2, H6, and H8 are left unresolved but closed: their point estimates are very small or in the wrong direction, although their intervals are wide enough that I cannot formally exclude a clinically meaningful effect. H5, H11, and H12 are unresolved and deferred because they involve relatively common binary markers (feature_002 and feature_034) with signed point estimates around 1.4-1.6 units, below threshold but in plausible directions, and they motivate focused subgroup-context follow-ups rather than broad new screening. I registered refinements of the near-signal markers: the feature_060 effect in a feature_002-defined subgroup, feature_002 effects in feature_034 and feature_008 contexts, and the feature_034 effect in a feature_002 context. These comparisons have large cells and remain within the same discovery dataset, so they can refine where the initial weak signals reside without immediately claiming generalizability. All conclusions remain observational; predictor labels are opaque, confounding or cohort structure cannot be ruled out, and causal interpretation is not supported at this stage.

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.

expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.
By omitting evidence in an assessment, you assess all evidence displayed on that claim's card;
the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.
An unchanged assessment or an investigation-only change can use evidence: [];
changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

record.narrative:
Synthesis of wave 1 and the newly released validation leaves the accepted claim set empty. No discovery comparison provides evidence for a clinically meaningful association in the hypothesized direction, and the only candidate strong enough to validate, H3, did not reproduce.

H3 tested outcome_006 for feature_060=1 versus feature_060=0 under direction -1, i.e. the hypothesis that exposed samples would have a more negative, stronger-dependency score. The signed discovery estimate was +0.0194 with a 95% interval approximately spanning zero, so the discovery data alone were suggestive but not sufficient. The independent validation signed estimate was -0.0065, the opposite of the hypothesized direction, with a validation interval of about -0.055 to +0.042. The validation alpha is smaller because it accounts for the maximum number of validation comparisons in the run, so the interval remains wide and does not formally exclude a clinically meaningful effect in either direction. However, the point estimate reversed, and the combined evidence does not support a reproducible feature_060 effect on outcome_006 in the claimed direction. Therefore H3 remains unresolved and is closed as a direct follow-up target rather than accepted or rejected: there is no support for acceptance, but the validation interval is too wide to reject all clinically relevant magnitudes. I do not reverse H3 because post-validation reversal would be data-driven and would worsen multiplicity.

The rejected directional claims H4, H7, H9, and H10 represent negative findings within the stated directional hypotheses: their signed 95% upper bounds fall below roughly a 10% relative magnitude for their outcome means, so those claims lack clinically meaningful support. H1, H2, H6, and H8 remain unresolved and closed because their point estimates are small or wrong in sign, but their intervals are wide enough that a clinically meaningful opposite effect is not definitively excluded. The near-threshold signal cluster is feature_002 and feature_034 with feature_008/feature_034 context markers, seen in H5, H11, and H12. These remain unresolved: their signed point estimates are below the clinical threshold, but their intervals include values that could be clinically meaningful. This motivates focused localization rather than continued broad screening of the same markers.

I closed H13 because it was a direct follow-up to the now-unsupported feature_060 H3 candidate, and closed H15 because it duplicates the already-evaluated H12 comparison. I activated the parent context claims H5, H11, and H12 as active research threads and registered two evidence-based subgroup refinements: outcome_008 for feature_002 within feature_008=1, and outcome_004 for feature_002 within feature_034=1. These complement the already active feature_002-within-feature_034 and feature_034-within-feature_002 comparisons. The next analysis should prioritize these large-cell context tests. A new claim would be acceptable only if its signed lower bound clearly exceeds the outcome-specific 10% relative threshold; if the signed upper bound is clearly below threshold, the directional claim should be rejected; otherwise it should remain unresolved and be considered for validation or closure without causal interpretation. All conclusions remain observational, predictor labels are opaque, and these results do not establish causality or generalizability beyond the supplied dataset and independent validation split.

record.narrative: I refocus on the near-threshold marker-outcome cluster from wave 1: feature_002 with outcome_004 and outcome_008, and feature_034 with outcome_016. I registered two high-power full-population mean-difference tests to ask whether the subgroup near-signals are diluted or generalizable across the full sample. For interactions, direction -1 tests whether feature_002's raw effect is more negative in the subgroup than in the complement; direction +1 tests whether feature_034's raw effect is more positive in the subgroup than in the complement. No new comparison should be accepted unless its signed interval lower bound exceeds the outcome-specific 10% relative threshold; interactions should be interpreted as heterogeneity evidence, with a clinically meaningful direct subgroup or full-population effect still required for a dependency claim. These comparisons remain observational, labels are opaque, correlated outcomes and confounding remain possible, and independent validation should be reserved for direct effects that are sufficiently strong in the discovery data.

Each iteration proceeds through explore (propose comparisons), analyze (request tests), appraise (assess the resulting discovery evidence and optionally request validation), and synthesize (assess validation and update conclusions and plans).

Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous
results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful
throughout the run. Assess discoveries in this supplied dataset and use independent validation when
useful. Biological interpretation and generalizability may remain uncertain.

Register comparisons, anticipated directions, and initial assessments before requesting analyses.
The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link
refinements to the earlier parent claim.
Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.
Returned estimates and intervals are ALREADY SIGNED to the indicated hypothesis direction. Do not
multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.
Discovery analyses use 95% Welch intervals and need at least 20 observations in every
comparison cell.

Each iteration has explore, analyze, appraise, and synthesize stages. Every stage may register
hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.
Appraise assesses every new discovery result, records active/deferred/closed investigation, and may
request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

Predictor names and text categorical values use opaque labels. Levels are nominal labels, not ordered numbers. Numeric values, outcome scales, and missingness are preserved.


You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.
For this task, a relative difference in outcome of 10% or greater is considered clinically significant.
Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

The ledger contains every registered claim, its current assessment, and all its available direct
evidence. References H1, H2, ... identify claims; R1, R2, ... identify evidence. Copy these short
references when needed. New proposals receive references automatically after this stage. A changed
comparison or reversed claim is a new proposal, optionally linked to an existing parent.
Proposal direction is the claim (+1 positive, -1 negative); anticipated_direction is your
expectation
of the raw exposed-minus-comparator contrast before seeing evidence (-1, 0 uncertain, +1).
initial_status is your assessment at registration. These initial judgments are recorded once.
If a proposal repeats an existing claim, the controller preserves that claim's current assessment;
use assessments to change a scientific conclusion.

For each claim in assessments_due, return one assessment with claim,
status (accept/reject/unresolved),
and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep
their current assessment. Assess the original claim even when proposing a refinement or reversal.

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.
For a refinement, parent identifies the earlier claim; omitted motivating_evidence attaches the
parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

The controller maintains the accepted set from your assessments. Do not reconstruct it. Optional
research_notes replaces your persistent notebook; omit it to keep the existing notes. Use it for
plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.
Omit unused fields.

Study instructions:

results to allocate further investigation. Broad exploration and focused follow-up are both useful

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are
retained for inspection. Acceptance does not require prior independent validation.

You are investigating the supplied research dataset. Return one JSON object using
only this stage's response form. The service performs analyses; you choose the science.

Use your judgment about uncertainty and conclusions in light of this clinical significance threshold. Acceptance does not require
independent validation first. Explain your reasoning in narrative.

expectation

and investigation (active/deferred/closed). You may also reassess other claims. Omitted claims keep

the controller attaches those references. To specify a subset or related evidence, provide evidence
with short R references; include the evidence listed in assessments_due for that claim.

changing accept/reject/unresolved requires available evidence. Bookkeeping does not satisfy a due
evidence assessment.

parent's displayed evidence. These automatic links record evidence supplied for your assessment
or refinement, not proof that you discussed or understood every result.

plans or reasoning worth retaining. Latest stage narratives are also retained. All earlier numerical
evidence remains in the ledger. Do not repeat completed actions or old responses.

record.narrative: None of the newly delivered wave-3 comparisons meets the acceptance bar for a scientifically meaningful association in the hypothesized direction. Acceptance would require a signed 95% interval lower bound clearly above the approximate 10% relative scale threshold: about 0.025 for outcome_004 and outcome_016, and about 0.028 for outcome_008. No direct claim satisfies this. For H15 and H19, the signed upper bounds (about 0.024 and 0.023) are below the approximate outcome_004 threshold, so the maximum clinically meaningful effect in the claimed direction is not supported; I rejected those directional claims and closed them. These rejections are directional: they do not exclude an opposite effect, but reversing post hoc would be data-driven and would worsen multiplicity. H14, H16, H17, and H20 remain unresolved: their point estimates are below threshold and intervals include zero, but the upper bounds exceed the approximate clinical threshold, so I cannot reject them outright. I kept H17 active because it is the strongest direct near-threshold signal (outcome_008, feature_002 within feature_008=1), and deferred H14/H16/H20 to avoid overextending on weak context-specific estimates. The interaction H24 is the strongest heterogeneity signal: outcome_008 feature_002 contrast is nominally about 0.048 signed units larger in the feature_008=1 subgroup than in the feature_008=0 complement, above the point threshold, but its interval still includes zero and is wide because the complement cells are smaller. I kept H24 active rather than accepting or rejecting it. Interactions H21, H22, and H23 are much weaker and/or include zero; I deferred H21 but closed H22 and H23 as heterogeneity follow-ups. I did not request validation this iteration because no direct claim is strong enough that an independent interval, which will be more conservative after accounting for the maximum number of validations, is likely to convert the current evidence into acceptance. Instead, I registered three focused complement mean-difference tests to characterize whether the near-signal direct effects and H24 interaction are localized: outcome_008 feature_002 in feature_008=0, outcome_016 feature_034 in feature_002=0, and outcome_008 feature_002 in feature_034=0. Study instructions:
Investigate diverse, scientifically meaningful comparisons and use previous

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
censoring. Dependency scores are continuous; more negative values mean stronger dependency.
A mean_difference is exposed minus comparator within eligibility and subgroup. An interaction
subtracts that comparison in the subgroup complement in the same eligible population.
Use your scientific judgment to assess the size, uncertainty, and importance of each effect
and decide which conclusions the evidence supports. Explain your reasoning in the narrative.

multiply them by direction again. For example, raw -0.4 with direction -1 is reported as +0.4.

comparison cell.

hypotheses for later analysis. Analyze selects up to 12 previously registered hypotheses.

request validation after considering those results. At most one new voluntary validation request
is allowed per iteration and ten per run. Cached requests reuse the same evidence. The evaluator
may also deliver scheduled validation during the run. Independent intervals account for the maximum
number of validation comparisons in the run. Results arrive before synthesis. Assess newly released
validation immediately in synthesis and explicitly reassess the original claim when its response
deadline appears in the context, even if you also investigate a refinement. The controller maintains
the accepted claim set from your assessments; you do not need to repeat that list. Explanations are

For the sole released validation, H3 tested feature_060 against outcome_006. Its signed discovery estimate was modestly positive but compatible with no effect, and the independent signed estimate reversed direction while remaining imprecise because the validation interval accounts for the maximum number of validation comparisons in the run. Therefore H3 is not accepted; it remains unresolved but closed as a direct follow-up target. I do not reverse it because that would be a post-hoc, data-driven reversal after seeing validation. H17 is the strongest direct near-threshold signal, but its signed lower bound is below zero and below the approximate 10% absolute-outcome-scale threshold for outcome_008. H24 is the strongest heterogeneity signal, with a signed interaction estimate above the approximate outcome_008 threshold, but its interval still includes zero and is wide because the complement cells are smaller. I did not request validation because validation would be more conservative and because H25-H27 can tell us whether the direct near-signal and H24 interaction are localized or diluted. If H25 or another complementary direct test shows the context-specific pattern while the complement is null, H24 could become a better validation candidate. The newly registered proposals test whether the feature_002 signal extends to outcome_005, outcome_013, outcome_014, and outcome_006, and whether the feature_034 signal extends to outcome_015, outcome_012, and outcome_010. Outcome_014 and outcome_006 have smaller absolute means, so the approximate 10% scale thresholds are smaller: about 0.009 and 0.018, respectively; I will therefore interpret their intervals cautiously. These are observational associations in the supplied dataset only. Predictor labels are opaque, outcomes are correlated, confounding is possible, and no causal or generalizable biological interpretation is established by the current evidence.

Study instructions:

The controller assigns claim references. For a changed claim, propose a new comparison and link

Clinical log_pfs_months is natural log progression-free survival in months, fully observed without
